06-22.solution: Let the sums be \(3x\) and \(4x\). The interests are \(3x \times 0.16 = 0.48x\) and \(4x \times 0.2 = 0.8x\). The difference \(0.32x = 160\) gives \(x = 500\), so the larger sum is \(4x = 2000\).

06-23.solution: The sum earns \(\frac{1}{5}\) of itself in \(2\) years, so \(\frac{1}{10}\) a year. To become \(\frac{7}{5}\) of itself it must earn \(\frac{2}{5}\): \(\frac{2}{5} \div \frac{1}{10} = 4\) years.
